E160 primary-source audit excerpt

Source type: primary source
URL: https://users.renyi.hu/~p_erdos/1989-35.pdf
Retrieved: 2026-07-14 05:27:48 JST (UTC+09:00)
PDF location: PDF page 12; printed page 143
PDF SHA-256: ce525a816bc16714a8c5b1a1db9f272c5715bfe8b735a515b8d11d39204182dc

Short verbatim excerpt:
"Let h(n) be the largest integer for which if we decompose the integers 1, 2, ..., n into h(n) disjoint sets"

Context (paraphrase): Erdős then requires that two parts always have a union
containing a four-term arithmetic progression, and asks to determine or
estimate h(n). The source does not explicitly state that every displayed part
must be nonempty.
